item.title: Deal reached on $590M loan to prop up Bay Area transit agencies
item.description: State and local officials have agreed on a $590 million bridge loan to prop up Bay Area transit agencies until voters decide on a sales tax increase to bolster the systems. The post Deal reached on $590M loan to prop up Bay Area transit agencies appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: PG&E purchases Stoneridge Mall Road property from Workday
item.description: After months on the market, an office site that previously served as part of Workday’s Pleasanton headquarters is now in new hands, with PG&E set to be the latest company situated at the prominent property near the West Dublin/Pleasanton BART station. The post PG&E purchases Stoneridge Mall Road property from Workday appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Pleasanton school board discusses equity gaps in marginalized student communities
item.description: Racism and equity gaps for certain demographics of students in PUSD took the center stage during a recent school board meeting where staff discussed different ways the district continues to address these issues. item.title: Quakes shake Tri-Valley, with strongest at 4.3-magnitude so far
item.description: A cluster of earthquakes shook parts of the East Bay on Monday morning, with the strongest reaching a preliminary magnitude of 4.3 near San Ramon, per USGS. The post Quakes shake Tri-Valley, with strongest at 4.3-magnitude so far appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.
